name: Emily Schaible
body: Paul and I hung in the same social circles all the way back to high school; we were friendly but not necessarily friends on our own. Best friends of the same best friends. So it's no surprise the last two times I saw Paul was in support of our mutual bud.. first at the Monty Are I reunion show... He and I sat at the bar and had a long, honest conversation about life, love and getting older. We were old friends without even realizing it. We were both so proud to celebrate our friend. The last time was in celebration of Andrew again, at his wedding. Watching him be Andrew's best man was a blast, he filled the room with his joyful, goofball, great guy energy. I'm happy to say I knew him. Much love to Brittany and Oli.
